'''Corvek''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gand/Legends|Gand]] who worked for [[Oridelve Incorporated]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gavos]]. He tried to escape the [[Gavos Droid Revolution]] at the beginning, but he was killed by [[Lookout (droid)|Lookout]].
